clos.enriched_description: Understand the fundamentals of trading. The scope includes Introduction to Trading with Machine learning on Google Cloud; Machine Learning in Finance and your first model using Google Cloud; Why Google Cloud Platform?; Learn ML interactively with Jupyter Notebooks on Cloud AI Platform; Trading Fundamentals: Quant Theory, Arbitrage, and Back-testing; and Example BigQuery ML DNN code.

clos.original_description: Define quantitative trading and the main types of quantitative trading strategies.
clos.enriched_description: Define quantitative trading and major quantitative trading strategy types using supervised learning concepts. The scope includes BigQuery ML model types, regression modeling for AAPL stock data, and example BigQuery ML deep neural network code for financial modeling contexts.

clos.original_description: Basic steps in exchange arbitrage, statistical arbitrage, index arbitrage and the application of machine learning to financial use cases.
clos.enriched_description: Basic steps in exchange arbitrage, statistical arbitrage, index arbitrage and the application of machine learning to financial use cases. The scope includes Building an ARIMA Model for a Financial Dataset, Introduction to Neural networks and Deep learning, and Deep Learning.

Design basic quantitative trading strategies. The scope includes Introduction to Quantitative trading and TensorFlow; Introduction to TensorFlow, Trading, ML; and Understand Quantitive Trading Strategies.

clos.original_description: Use Keras and Tensorflow to build machine learning models.
clos.enriched_description: Use Keras and Tensorflow to build machine learning models. The scope includes Traning neural networks with TensorFlow 2 and Keras, Overview of Neural Networks and Introduction to Keras APIs, Introducing the Keras Sequential API, and The Keras Functional API.

clos.original_description: Build a pair trading strategy prediction model, a momentum-based trading model, and back test them.
clos.enriched_description: Build pair-trading and momentum-based trading prediction models and back-test them. The scope includes momentum factor identification, momentum strategies, pair selection, pair-trading strategy design, backtesting, avoiding overfitting, cost-aware optimization, Kalman-filter parameter estimation, and pairs trading assignments.

clos.original_description: Understand the structure and techniques used in reinforcement learning (RL) strategies.
clos.enriched_description: Understand the structure and techniques used in reinforcement learning (RL) strategies. The scope includes Introduction to Course and Reinforcement Learning and Early Reinforcement Learning.

clos.original_description: Understand the benefits of using RL vs. other learning methods.
clos.enriched_description: Understand the benefits of using RL vs. other learning methods. The scope includes Neural network based reinforcement learning and What is LSTM and How to apply it.

clos.original_description: Describe the steps required to develop, test, and optimize an RL trading strategy.
clos.enriched_description: Describe the steps required to develop, test, and optimize an RL trading strategy. The scope includes Portfolio optimization, Investment and Trading portfolio optimization, Auto ML, and Reinforcement Learning DQN.
